slides.texte_overlay:
Skills that make people
want to be around you
Remembering people's stories. Their new job, their trip, their dog's name. Asking about it later makes people feel important.
Being easy to plan with. Quick replies, flexible, on time. People love friends who make life simpler. Be that friend.
Bringing calm to tense moments. Arguments, delays, problems. A steady man makes everyone around him feel safer.
Sharing what you love with enthusiasm. A book, a band, a recipe. Passion is contagious and makes you fun to talk to.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Fresh stories make every conversation better.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Fresh stories make every conversation better.

slides.texte_overlay: Being generous without keeping score. Paying for coffee, helping with a move, giving your time. People remember.
Knowing how to listen. Full attention, good questions, no rushing to talk. It's the rarest social skill of all.
